**Procedure for entering licences and other rights in the Register**

1. Article 20(1) and (2), the rules laid down pursuant to Article 20(4) and Article 20(6) shall apply mutatis mutandis to the registration of a right in rem or transfer of the right in rem as referred to in Article 22(1) and (2), the levy of execution referred to in Article 23(1), the involvement in insolvency proceedings referred to in Article 24(3) and to the registration of a licence or transfer of a licence as referred to in Article 25(5), subject to the following:

3. The application for registration of a licence may contain a request to record the licence in the Register as one or more of the following:

(a) an exclusive licence;

(b) a sub-licence in the event that the licence is granted by a licensee whose licence is recorded in the Register;

(c) a licence limited to only a part of the goods or services for which the mark is registered;

(d) a licence limited to part of the Union;

(e) a temporary licence.

4. Where a request is made to record the licence as a licence referred to in points (c), (d) and (e) of paragraph 3, the application for registration of a licence shall indicate the goods and services, the part of the Union and the time period for which the licence is granted.

5. 6. Paragraphs 1 and 3 shall apply mutatis mutandis to applications for EU trade marks.
